# Link

Inline text link: fg text with a thin accent-border underline that turns accent-fg and thicker on hover — the red, on purpose.

`KenosUI.Link` · Typography

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Link />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Link"></x-import>
```

## Props (LinkProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"underline" \| "plain"` | "underline" (default, red underline) or "plain" (underline on hover). |
| `external` | `boolean` | Opens in a new tab and adds an external-link icon. |

_Also accepts: React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>._
